description: When Sheriff Gilbert learned that a young boy from the tribe that protected the mines had been kidnapped by a gang of bandits, his rage shook the heavens. As he and the young girl with the relic gun approached the bandits' hideout, the courage of the young hostage would prove to be the ace up their sleeve that would lead them to victory. After rescuing the young boy the locals who feared Gilbert had a change of heart, making the sheriff's heart swell with pride. Not only did he manage to capture the bandits that attacked his town, he was regarded as a hero and keeper of the peace ever since.
summon: Who made you cry? I'll give 'em a stern talkin' to when I capture 'em!Wonder how tough they'll be then. Ha ha ha!
fusion: Oh, I can hear 'em!People chantin' my name!Feels like my heart's about to burst, and my shirt with it!
evolution: You just watch, I'll make this desert bloom with flowers and smiles!Hope you'll be smilin' then, from the bottom of your heart.
